Name: (1.6) Iridium Recolors with Coordinated Crafting Bars
Description:
[b][center][url=https://ko-fi.com/6480k]If you like my work, consider leaving a tip ♥[/url][/center][/b]
Choose between fifteen different color schemes. Everything that is vaguely iridium-related or stardrop-related has been recolored.

[b](1.6) Animated Iridium Ore and Bars
[/b]When you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] installed, you have the option of enabling a glowing/shine animation on Iridium Ore, Iridium nodes, Iridium Bars, and Meteors.

[b](1.6) Recolored Fishing Rod animations
[/b]When you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25258]Colorful Fishing Rods[/url] installed, Iridium fishing rods will automatically become the correct color when fishing, which was previously not possible to do.

[b]Coordinated Crafting Bars
[/b]Version 2.0 has an option to make the iridium bar, radioactive bar, and refined quartz match the shape of all other ore bars! You can use this even if you aren't using any of the recolors from this mod. This option was inspired by the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/554]Coordinated Crafting Bars[/url] by yifalchunbee, though all assets are redrawn by me.

﻿[b]Iridium Desaturation
[/b]Do you like earthy-toned recolor mods? Not to worry, this mod [i]also[/i] has a "desaturated" version of every single color offered, to make your iridium items match your aesthetic! Just toggle on the global "Desaturate All" option in the config, or adjust the different desaturation options to your liking.

[b]Stardrop Shape
[/b]An optional adjustment to the stardrop is included to make it more "star" shaped. Just like the coordinated bars, you can use this even if you don't want to use any of the recolors from the mod.

[b]Animal Tools
[/b]There are optional settings to recolor your milk pail and shears to match all of your iridium tools. [b]The golden scythe can no longer be recolored as of the 1.6 update, as there is now a vanilla Iridium Scythe.

Compatibility
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] (some weapons and items)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25361]Iridium Cat and Dog[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25938]Vanilla Tweaks[/url]﻿ (use this patch mod)

Please feel free to drop suggestions in the comments section if you feel like this mod is missing something.
[b]Before reporting a bug, first make sure that no other mods are overwriting an item sprite you think is broken. Screenshots are also very helpful.[/b]

A big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/74594308]ShilohAreles[/url] for helping me get the 1.5 update out. Some of the color palettes are partially their work (rose, cotton candy), but all of the assets still fall under my asset permission rules, which say that you can use and modify any of the art in this mod for use in any Stardew Valley mod, with credit.

Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BeazNees/about-me?gameId=1303]BeazNees[/url] for contributing some assets for the Advanced Iridium Rod and Iridium Pan to the 1.6 update.

This mod does not change:
- Stardrop consumption particle effects
- Purple slime color (since they're called purple slimes in-game, and slime breeding would become very ugly if you mixed some of these colors with other slimes)

[b]Also recommended:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19229]B's Alternative Cat Statues[/url][b] [/b]so the statue of endless fortune can match the other two stylistically (set it to load before this one if you want the iridium colors to be changed correctly).

Install instructions:
- Download SMAPI
- Download Content Patcher
- Optionally download Spacecore and Colorful Fishing Rods for more features
- Download this mod and drag the folder inside to your "Mods" folder.
- Run the game once to generate the config.json (you can close it right after)
- Open config.json and change the settings to which color you want. Color names are listed in the images, as well as in example images inside the mod.
